 Judgment
(Dated this the 7th day of January, 2025)

The Land Acquisition proceedings were initiated against the petitioner's property under Section 77(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act, 2013').

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: A sum of Rs.6,02,391/- was passed on 25.11.2022 in L.A.C.No.30 of 2021 and the possession was taken on 9.12.2022.

Since the petitioner did not appear, pursuant to the notice, to produce the title deeds, the amount was deposited in the Court and was referred to the appellate authority under Section 77(2)
of the Act 2013.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in Ext.P2 to P4, the extent of the property is clearly shown as 0.11 Ares.
But in Ext.P6 and P7, which are the possession certificates in respect of the property, the extent of the property is shown as 0.10 Sq.Mts.
In L.A.R.No.73 of 2023, the resettlement authority found that the property in possession of the claimant is 0.10 Sq.meters.
Therefore, Ext.P9, I.A.No.1 of 2023 was filed to review the mistake that occurred in the extent of the land.
The said application was dismissed by Ext.P10 order, which is under challenge in this original petition.

OP(C) NO. 2295 OF 2024 2025:KER:950 3. Ext. P3 notice issued under the Land Acquisition Act shows that the extent of land is shown as 0.11 Ares, but in the possession certificate, it is shown as 0.10 Sq.Mts.
Therefore, there is some confusion regarding the extent of land acquired from the petitioner.
The Court below has simply rejected the application for review on the ground that no error is apparent on the face of the record.

When all the documents in respect of the acquisition proceedings holds that 0.11 Are is acquired and more particularly in the mahazar dated 9.12.2022, the court below ought to have made some enquiry and pass orders on I.A.1 of 2023.
Therefore, I deem it appropriate to set aside Ext.P10 directing to reconsider in the light of the Ext.P2 series.
This Original Petition is allowed as above.

Sd/-
